name: farm-tools-scad
description: Parametric OpenSCAD designs for small-scale farming tools.

name: Open Source Bioreactor
description: A parametric OpenSCAD bioreactor built on glass jars from 1.5 L to 6.5 gal.

name: Desktop Sheet Press
description: Control electronics, firmware and enclosure for a heated scientific sheet press.

name: UV Curing Box
description: A modular UV LED curing box built from identical 80 mm LED boards and printed brackets.

name: Nasopharyngeal Swab
description: A parametric OpenSCAD nasopharyngeal swab, printed in resin, with a lock or tong handle printed on an FFF printer.

name: openreactor
description: Supervise bench-scale reactors from a Raspberry Pi: sensor logging, heater and motor setpoints, and recorded runs, in a web interface.

name: Feedstock Hopper
description: A parametric, printable hopper for plastic pellets and shredded regrind, with bayonet couplings and per-machine mounting plates.

name: Syringe Actuator
description: A printed crank that strokes a 1 to 30 mL luer syringe's plunger back and forth from a gearmotor that never reverses.

name: Mass Scale
description: A 3D-printed digital scale with a load cell, an HX711 and an Arduino Nano, read over serial for data logging, with its 2019 and 2020 predecessors.

name: pipe-fitting-scad
description: A parametric OpenSCAD generator for threaded pipe couplings: a fitting, nuts and tapered gaskets, with threads from threadlib.
